sentences.japanese: 苦しむことは人間の定めである。
sentences.english: It is man's lot to suffer.

sentences.japanese: 案の定、幽霊はバルコニーに現れた。
sentences.english: Sure enough, the ghost appeared on the balcony.

sentences.japanese: 案の定、彼女は電話をかけてきた。
sentences.english: She called me up, as I had expected.

sentences.japanese: 案の定、彼は第一位になった。
sentences.english: As was to be expected, he took the first place.

sentences.japanese: 案の定、彼は疑念を抱いていた。
